editorial.blurb: Palilgu nails modern Korean cooking with thoughtful preparation and balanced flavors, from their legendary Korean fried chicken to more refined dishes that feel both comforting and elevated.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Palilgu wings with soy garlic sauce and corn cheese as must-tries, and don't skip the tteokbokki—it has the perfect chewy texture. Ask your server for recommendations if you're spice-sensitive, as some dishes pack serious heat.
signatureDishes: Palilgu wings with soy garlic sauce
